recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-30093 needs no further core source work unless a future Pharmacy decision changes indication binding or guideline semantics beyond this cardinality request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request for R5 asking that MedicationKnowledge administrationGuideline indication support more than one indication; the final resolution applied this after the FHIR-28597 relationship inversion as IndicationGuideline.indication 0..* CodeableReference(ClinicalUseIssue), with AdministrationGuideline renamed to DosingGuideline.
initial_application: Commit 1683ac64141af807564d62a28932d70133142fb3 introduced MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.indication as 0..* CodeableReference(ClinicalUseIssue). Commit bd0883f3912523b0e63ae2a99a8a3a5b353c50a2 produced the final sibling DosingGuideline structure under indicationGuideline, and 5af327bef84d35d0b85e3535c304cc9090d4d898 corrected the indication short text. The current ClinicalUseDefinition target came from the later ClinicalUseIssue rename work in b749d029049da7124fff4a982321bc8447c43f61.
additional_context: FHIR-28597 supplies the relationship inversion that changes the apparent old path administrationGuideline.indication into the current indicationGuideline.indication. source/fhir.ini confirms MedicationKnowledge and ClinicalUseDefinition are active current-build entries, while ClinicalUseIssue is not the active resource name. Pharmacy WGM minutes record the FHIR-30093 resolution and 12-0-0 vote, and OO catalog minutes note that the MedicationKnowledge trackers including FHIR-30093 had been accepted and applied by Pharmacy. No direct Zulip hit was found that conflicts with this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml already defines MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.indication with min 0, max *, CodeableReference, and targetProfile ClinicalUseDefinition. The checked-in SVG also displays [0..*], but the XML source is the authoritative build input.
